E0_counts.scenario_warning: Scenario arithmetic using old query cost, NOT runtime prediction. Long new tasks may exceed this. End with explicit incomplete manifest, do not drop demos.
E0_counts.order: Complete all P12 base/G1 pairs first (H and E tier-interleaved); then remaining H-new/E24 in predeclared tier-interleaved order. 2.5h cap does not promise all 98 pairs-of-arm generations. Record unfinished tasks explicitly.

matched_training_protocol.init: Same weight checkpoint selected after E0; same fresh optimizer/RNG; no F0->F1 sequential inheritance
matched_training_protocol.raw_order: Parent prepares and freezes 400 common raw episodes from CPU materialization, excluding repair-pair ID collisions; F0<=4096 and F1<=4096. Two formats preserve same raw id/order, demos/query/target/augmentation. Trainer legacy without length-mixture, max_len=overflow_len=4096, identical seed and identical candidate pool order must produce same actual shuffle and consumption prefix. Verify consumed IDs exactly; do not depend on current fair-task-base grouping bug. No independent per-format bucket selection.
matched_training_protocol.schedule: Both runs have lr2e-5,warmup10,horizon100,save25/50/100. Pause at25/50 without changing schedule horizon. Exact resume for continuation; never restart schedule from50.
matched_training_protocol.selection: F0 vs F1 at matched checkpoints answers representation under same examples, not fair-vs-legacy or extra-F1-coverage benefit. Only one conditional branch gets100. Compare equal-update and equal-wall separately.
matched_training_protocol.evaluation: F0/F1 step0 before training; repeated P12 at25/50; inspect health/loss at25, do not treat one-query difference as decisive. Pick one final checkpoint then confirm once.
matched_training_protocol.all_shortfall: If a cap/OOM prevents matched checkpoints, compare only last common checkpoint and consumed raw prefix; record remaining work as unrun.

minimum_decisions: Whether original G1 has positive/negative paired evidence on H-new/E24 vs base
Whether F1 preserves/retrieves solved tasks while reducing actual training/inference cost on identical raw episodes
Whether a second transformed candidate adds useful solves beyond same-view sample, and whether bounded task-local adaptation merits further budget
stop_conditions: On OOM/NaN/schema mismatch, stop affected arm and save logs; do not silently truncate/rewrite episodes or silently fallback format
Do not start a new task/update unless the remaining phase and quota budget includes measured p90 work plus save time
No improvement at format50 and no complementary solves: do not auto-expand both arms to100
A1 no new solves: skip 4view/16step/NLL rerank expansion; TTT no signal: keep as negative pilot
Quota multiplier anomaly: reconcile active sessions and conservatively reduce following job. Reserve is not free funding until actual accounting is known
Do not train on public evaluation query answers, confirmation query answers, or original H holdout families
resource_reuse: One base load per coherent session; adapter states around160MB can be CPU saved/restored between arms, optimizer states separate
No repeat model load per query or per checkpoint; invalidate cache across adapter/formatter changes
Prepare wheels/tokenizer/materialized pools/manifests on CPU before enabling accelerator; record actual startup after accelerator allocation
Reuse exact matching E0 greedy outputs as A1 baseline; generate only new sample/transform/TTT candidates
H25 history bridge is low priority after new representative questions; reuse prior20 G1 greedy only under matching model/code/formatter/generation settings
